exact_query: SELECT prefname, prefphytype, ra, dec, z, zunc, zflag, z_bibcode, n_zdf FROM NEDTAP.objdir WHERE ra BETWEEN 341.479904 AND 342.882676 AND dec BETWEEN -45.030780 AND -44.030780 AND CONTAINS(POINT('ICRS',ra,dec),CIRCLE('ICRS',342.18129,-44.53078,0.5))=1 AND z IS NOT NULL AND zflag LIKE 'S%'

source_columns.name: zflag
source_columns.description: NED redshift flag; leading S = spectroscopic

source_columns.name: n_zdf
source_columns.description: Number of redshift data frames in NED

extraction: NED TAP ADQL cone search, TSV output. Cleaned file maps NED columns to the standard schema and appends sep_arcmin and R_proj_Mpc computed from the cluster centre with FlatLambdaCDM(H0=70,Om0=0.3). obj_type and z_bibcode retained so each redshift stays traceable to its originating publication. No rows dropped, no values altered. Raw response kept verbatim in raw/ with the exact query and job URL in its header.
note: Abell S1063 = RXC J2248.7-4431 (z=0.348). 290 spectroscopic redshifts within 30 arcmin. This is a POOR substitute for the real catalogue: Mercurio et al. 2021, A&A 656, A147 ('CLASH-VLT: Abell S1063. Cluster assembly history and spectroscopic catalogue') reports ~3600 redshifts and 1234 spectroscopically confirmed members from VLT/VIMOS+MUSE, but that table is NOT deposited at CDS (cdsarc.cds.unistra.fr/ftp/J/A+A/656/A147/ returns HTTP 404 and the VizieR identifier J/A+A/656/A147 does not resolve). Neither are Caminha et al. 2016 (A&A 587, A80), Karman et al. 2015 (A&A 574, A11) or Karman et al. 2017 (A&A 599, A28). The NED compilation here does pick up individual redshifts from some of those papers (e.g. z_bibcode 2017A&A...599A..28K), but only a small fraction of them. Consequence: only a small number of these 290 are cluster members, so a resolved sigma(R) field for Abell S1063 CANNOT be built from this product. *** HETEROGENEOUS LITERATURE COMPILATION - NOT A HOMOGENEOUS SURVEY. *** Source: NASA/IPAC Extragalactic Database (NED) Table Access Protocol service, table NEDTAP.objdir, cone search of radius 30 arcmin, restricted to objects with a non-null redshift whose NED redshift flag (zflag) begins with 'S', i.e. SPECTROSCOPIC determinations only (photometric 'P*', model 'M*' and unknown 'U*' redshifts were excluded by the query). Each row carries z_bibcode, the literature reference NED took that redshift from, so the provenance is traceable per galaxy - but the sample is the union of many different programmes with different instruments, magnitude limits, colour preselections and sky footprints. There is therefore NO single well-defined selection function, and the radial completeness is unknown and certainly non-uniform. NED's zflag is retained verbatim in q_flag. There is no membership flag; membership must be derived downstream. This product is used only because no homogeneous machine-readable survey catalogue for this cluster is obtainable from VizieR/CDS (see the product-level NOT_FOUND record).
